# Nevamis

> Nevamis answers the calls a Canadian trades or service business misses,
> 24/7, in the business's name. The business keeps its own number: call
> forwarding sends the calls nobody picks up to Nevamis. The agent asks the
> caller what they need, where it is and how urgent it is, takes their name
> and callback number, and texts and emails the owner those details within
> seconds. Nothing else: it books nothing and transfers no call. Based in
> Edmonton, Alberta. Nevamis publishes no client counts or results.

## Prices

In Canadian dollars, plus GST/HST. No setup fee. The same front desk in three
sizes:

- Front Desk Starter: C$250 a month, 200 included minutes.
- Front Desk Plus: C$500 a month, 550 included minutes.
- AI Front Desk: C$1,000 a month, 1,400 included minutes.

Month to month from the first month: no minimum term and no cancellation
notice. Cancel any time from the portal and keep the month you paid for.
The price is locked for 12 months from signing.

## Book

- Book a 15-minute call: https://nevamis.ca/book.html
- Hear it answer: call +1 (587) 413-0035, any hour.
